name: Cuckoo
status: The ESP32-C3 image has run on one board. The RP2354A images it carries have not run yet.
connect: Plug Cuckoo's USB-C into this computer. That powers it too.
Press Connect and pick USB JTAG/serial debug unit (Espressif, 303a:1001).
bootMode: Hold TP7 (ESP_BOOT, GPIO9) to ground and plug the USB-C back in.
Let go of TP7 and press Connect.
